useCase: Detecting geometric 不一致 and impossible 透视s in AI生成的 architectural/scene images
mechanism: 检测 straight lines using Hough Transform and estimates vanishing points from line intersections. 验证 geometric consistency by checking that parallel lines in 3D converge to consistent vanishing points. AI生成的 scenes often violate projective geometry rules, creating physically impossible 透视s.
accuracy: 中等 - 68-78% on images with clear geometric structures
name: 透视几何分析
source: Farid (2009) - Image Forgery Detection, IEEE Signal Processing Magazine
parameters: Line 检测: Progressive Probabilistic Hough Transform, Min line length: 50px, Vanishing point: RANSAC estimation, Consistency 阈值: 5° angular deviation
description: 检查 geometric consistency of parallel lines, vanishing points, and depth cues. AI生成的 scenes often contain 透视 distortions that violate projective geometry rules.

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Conotter, V. et al. (2014). Physiologically-Based Detection of Computer Generated Faces in Video. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Based on projective geometry principles
• Effective for architectural and urban scenes
• 检测 physically impossible configurations
• Can identify subtle 透视 errors
limitations:
• Requires images with clear linear structures
• Ineffective for natural scenes without straight lines
• Curved surfaces may create 误报
• Wide-angle lens distortion complicates 分析
